result.prompt: The phone lies flat on an oak table, screen up, showing only that same blank cream rectangle and deep green bar. The cream coffee bag and a cup sit next to it. No face, no clock, no icons, no status bar. Natural Scandinavian daylight, the kind in a real Danish home, a small café, or the Aarhus roastery. Shot on a normal camera, a little imperfect, quiet and specific. Not a stock photo, not glossy advertising, not CGI, and not a catalog render. Any person is an ordinary adult, varied and natural, caught mid-action rather than posing. Not a recognizable real person, not a celebrity, and not a model on a set. No real brand logos, no clothing logos, no shop signs, and no nameplates. When the coffee bag is visible, it is always the same bag: a matte cream paper coffee bag with a deep green rectangular label that is only a solid color block, and a small blank cream sticker where a roast date would go. The label and the sticker have no writing at all. No text anywhere in the photograph: no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names, no readable labels, no captions, and no interface copy.
